reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000575 (the melody read from 000575a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. J. E. Hawes's dates (1862–1933) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Hawes_JE (Hawes, James E., 1862-1933; 'born in Vermillion County, IL, near Danville, on Aug. 18, 1862', died 1933); https://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/no2017163219 (Hawes, J. E. (James Edward), 1862-1933; 'composer of many hymns and songs'; born August 18, 1862, died August 23, 1933); CCEH's page gives only the year 1917.
